mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, event_id, endpoint_id, status, attempts, attempts_base, replay_count, next_attempt_at, lease_until, last_status_code, last_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO delivery (tenant_id, event_id, endpoint_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at) VALUES
(#{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{endpointId}, 'PENDING', 0, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT id FROM delivery WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery SET status = 'IN_FLIGHT', attempts = attempts + 1, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseMs} * 1000 MICROSECOND) WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id, d.event_id, d.endpoint_id, d.attempts, d.attempts_base, e.type AS event_type, e.payload, e.created_at AS event_created_at, ep.url, ep.secret_ciphertext, ep.enabled AS endpoint_enabled, (ep.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS endpoint_deleted, ep.max_attempts, ep.deliver_qps FROM delivery d JOIN event e ON e.id = d.event_id JOIN endpoint ep ON ep.id = d.endpoint_id WHERE d.status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND d.id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_attempt (delivery_id, attempt_no, started_at, duration_ms, status_code, error, response_snippet) VALUES (#{deliveryId}, #{attemptNo}, #{startedAt}, #{durationMs}, #{statusCode}, #{error}, #{responseSnippet})
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery SET status = 'PENDING', lease_until = NULL, attempts = attempts - 1, next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delayMs} * 1000 MICROSECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND attempts = #{attempts}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT id, delivery_id, attempt_no, started_at, duration_ms, status_code, error, response_snippet FROM delivery_attempt WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} ORDER BY attempt_no
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery d JOIN endpoint ep ON ep.id = d.endpoint_id SET d.status = 'PENDING', d.attempts_base = d.attempts, d.replay_count = d.replay_count + 1, d.next_attempt_at = NOW(3), d.last_error = NULL WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.status = 'DEAD' AND ep.enabled = 1 AND ep.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE delivery d JOIN endpoint ep ON ep.id = d.endpoint_id SET d.status = 'PENDING', d.attempts_base = d.attempts, d.replay_count = d.replay_count + 1, d.next_attempt_at = NOW(3), d.last_error = NULL WHERE d.endpoint_id = #{endpointId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.status = 'DEAD' AND ep.enabled = 1 AND ep.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS due, COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, MIN(next_attempt_at), NOW(3)) / 1000000, 0) AS oldest_due_seconds FROM delivery WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM delivery WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'DEAD') GROUP BY status
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery SET status = 'PENDING', lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = NOW(3), last_error = 'lease expired' WHERE status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND lease_until < NOW(3) LIMIT #{limit}
